part.text:
Fixed. The provisioners only disconnected the communicator when the provisioner's context was cancelled (which never happens in a normal apply), so SSH connections stayed ESTABLISHED after the run.

Changes:
- `internal/builtin/provisioners/remote-exec/resource_provisioner.go:236` — `runScripts` now `defer comm.Disconnect()` instead of a goroutine waiting on `ctx.Done()`
- `internal/builtin/provisioners/file/resource_provisioner.go:168` — `copyFiles` now `defer comm.Disconnect()` after connecting, same goroutine removed

Verified: all `internal/builtin/provisioners/...` and `internal/communicator/...` tests pass (including `TestProvisionerTimeout`, which asserts disconnect after the command completes), full `go build ./...` and `go vet` are clean, and only the two provisioner files are modified.
